name: Mungey V2
summary:
Mungey V2 is an independently developed Gorilla Tag fangame built in Unity, featuring multiple distinct environments tied together by the iconic Mungey character — a dark-bodied humanoid with a round head, pale cartoon face, and ribbed chest plate.
The central hub is a moody bedroom with a bed, monitor setup, a Message Of The Day board, and dark particle-filled atmosphere.
